en.name: Andean Infrastructure & Construction Expo
en.description: Chinese construction technology and materials meeting Andean public and private infrastructure project leads.
en.metaTitle: Andean Infrastructure & Construction Expo | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Chinese construction technology and materials meeting Andean public and private infrastructure project leads. Medellín, 18–20 February 2026.
en.overviewHtml: A construction and infrastructure expo connecting Chinese building technology and materials suppliers with public and private project leads across the Andean region.
en.whoShouldAttendHtml: Infrastructure developers, construction technology suppliers, and government project offices.
en.formatHtml: Exhibition halls, technical briefings, and matchmaking for public and private infrastructure projects.

br.name: Expo Andina de Infraestrutura & Construcao

br.metaTitle: Expo Andina de Infraestrutura & Construcao | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Tecnologia e materiais de construcao chineses encontram lideres de projetos de infraestrutura publica e privada dos paises andinos. Em Medellin, 18–20 de fevereiro de 2026.
br.overviewHtml: Uma expo de construcao e infraestrutura que conecta fornecedores chineses de tecnologia e materiais de construcao a lideres de projetos publicos e privados da regiao andina.
br.whoShouldAttendHtml: Desenvolvedores de infraestrutura, fornecedores de tecnologia de construcao e escritorios de projetos governamentais.

cn.metaTitle: 安地斯基础设施与建筑博览会 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年2月18–20日，麦德林，中国建筑技术与材料供应商与安地斯地区公共及私营基础设施项目负责人对接。
cn.overviewHtml: 一场建筑与基础设施展览会，连接中国建筑技术与材料供应商与安地斯地区公共及私营项目负责人。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 基础设施开发商、建筑技术供应商，以及政府项目办公室。
